title: Technology Update: Scalable Vector Extension (SVE) for Armv8-A

passages.locator: Paragraphs beginning “SVE is targeted” and “The variable length aspect”
passages.note: The ISA architect identifies SVE as an extension solely for AArch64, using a portion of the existing A64 encoding space. The fixed-width instructions encode predication so vector length is handled without dedicating encoding bits to length.
